resell.label: Resell
resell.summary: Sell the product as-is through the resale channel when condition and demand are high.
resell.sustainabilityImpact: Full product reuse, no material processing

refurbish.label: Refurbish
refurbish.summary: Repair and recondition the product before resale to unlock value trapped by moderate damage.
refurbish.valueImpact: High recovered value after repair cost
refurbish.sustainabilityImpact: Extends product lifespan, reduces new manufacturing

exchange.label: Exchange
exchange.summary: Offer the unit as a replacement or trade-in for another return, avoiding a full repair cycle.

donate.label: Donate
donate.summary: Route functional but low-resale-value units to donation partners.

recycle.label: Recycle
recycle.summary: Recover raw materials from products that are damaged beyond economical repair.

writeOff.label: Write Off
writeOff.summary: Retire the unit when no route recovers meaningful value or material.
